collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: Hmm! Well met, young hell-walker! You are wise and powerful indeed to have passed this test.

collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: The Plaguelord Gregorie has bewitched many with his promises of hidden knowledge - only to devour their souls, wholesale.

collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: To have spurned his advances, and to slay this great hellbeast... such a feat is worthy of an artifact of REAL ANCIENT POWER!

collision_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
collision_actions.text: I'm confused... Gregorie is the bug I just stepped on?
collision_actions.cage: I fear the Greeks even when they bring gifts.

collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: ...oh. You didn't mean to slay him, then. Well, in that case I shall bestow upon you... this coffee mug!

collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: May its contents someday empower you to overcome mighty foes!

collision_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
collision_actions.cage: Maybe when this is all over you and I can stop by the souvenir shop but right now I just wanna find some ROCKETS!

collision_actions.speaker: MURMUR
collision_actions.text: The vessel may only carry that which exists inside of you...! Also, coffee.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: What's happenin', eh? Yeah, we're all stuck here because the projector broke. It's been a couple millennia since that there slide changed.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Why can't anyone fix it? Doesn't hell have, like... an IT department?
default_actions.cage: Feels like your skull's on fire, but I'm good.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: Oh, well yah, there was an IT Guy! But he got kidnapped by a dragon.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: There are dragons in hell?!
default_actions.cage: A spirit of vengeance... fighting fire with fire.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OH MY GOSH WHY DOES THAT KIND OF STUFF EVEN STILL SURPRISE YOU? WHAT A SCRUB.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: Hey, it's not like he's a BIG dragon. Total hoser, though. Also, his office is past that giant dog who drinks human blood.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: That's... not incredibly reassuring, but thanks.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: Yeah, it's a real shame aboot that dragon kidnapping thing. For one, WE'RE all trapped here... and the IT guy is trapped THERE...

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: The other thing, though, is that I never get to see the dragon's super-cute receptionist anymore. We totally had a rapport going, too!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hmm... I'm really curious about what's going on in that wing of the office.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: Well, don't get TOO curious! About the receptionist, I mean. I don't wanna have to kill you.

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: So you saved the IT guy from the dragon, didja? Maybe we'll finally be able to reach the end o' this meeting here!

default_actions.speaker: BEELZOTEN
default_actions.text: By the way, the dragon's receptionist... did she mention me at all? D'you think I have a shot?!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: A LADY MADE OF PAPER AND A DUDE WHO'S CONSTANTLY ON FIRE. YEAH, I AM OFFICIALLY OKAY WITH THIS.

scissors.speaker: BEELZOTEN
scissors.text: Ow! The heck? Did you just try to stab me with a pair of scissors?

scissors.speaker: BEELZOTEN
scissors.text: That's it! Get ready... for some RAAAAW DANGER!!!

scissors.epitaph: YOU'VE BEEN INCINERATED TO A CRISP. HEY, YOU WERE KIND OF ASKING FOR IT.

lens.text: Am I on fire? They - they would tell me if I was on fire again, right?

hatemail.speaker: BEELZOTEN
hatemail.text: Whoah, ouch! I'm a charred skeletal hell-being, not a thief. Stop bein' so suspicious.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: W... what on earth was this presentation supposed to be about?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: WELL, UM, YOU SEE... HRMM... YOU KNOW, THERE ARE CERTAIN THINGS YOU JUST CAN'T EXPLAIN TO FOOLISH MORTALS.

The slide finally changed! 
 ...and somehow I understand this presentation even less than before.

default_actions.text: LEAVE HIM BE, FOR PITY'S SAKE! CAN'T YOU TELL THAT HE IS AT HIS WIT'S ENDS?!

lens.speaker: FRUSTRATED DEVIL'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: At this rate... all my questions about 'HOWRSE' will go forever unanswered!

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: This conference room's tech troubles were a bit of biscuit to yours truly! Ah, it's good to be back in the crunch.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: I would never have escaped that cage if it weren't for you, chum. Any time you need tech support, you know who to call!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Oh, really? Because there's this elevator just outside this room, and I was hoping...
default_actions.cage: Bangers and mash! Bubbles and squeak!

default_actions.text: Turn it off and back on again.

TURN.

 AND BACK ON AGAIN.

scissors.speaker: IT GUY
scissors.text: OW! You cleft. Keep it up and you'll get a knuckle supper!

lens.speaker: IT GUY
lens.text: Huh, the printer I set up in this room is missing. Hope it's not my responsibility to worry about that.

hatemail.speaker: IT GUY
hatemail.text: You're really handing me this... snail mail? Tell me, which part of the Paleolithic Age do you hail from?!

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: The tale of this place is filled with woe. It was once a conference room, filled with light and joy abundant.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: However! In the midsts of an invaluable presentation, the projector here got stuck on a slide. That was 1,000 years ago.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: We have waited here ever since, for a hero to rise and undo this awful wrong. Then we can finish this meeting once and for all.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: Ha! Technology, right?

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: Well met, Pachinko Man! The cubic spirit who fixed our projector has told us of your deeds since I gifted you with my mug.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: For vanquishing Drachenroe and ending our tedium, I believe you have earned an artifact of real ancient power - the SOUL ANKH!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Wow, thanks! What does this item do?
default_actions.cage: Gimme that cake. I WANT IT.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: Oh, it's incredibly handy! You need only rub the Ankh's surface three times...

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: ...and an infernal death-god will emerge to devour the souls of the innocent.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.cage: What I'm dealing with here is one of the most deadly substances the earth has ever known...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: WHAT?! When would I EVER use that?
default_actions.cage: So cut me some FRIGGIN' slack!

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: Hey, you never know when a surplus of innocent souls is going to be an issue, right?

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: ...anyway, I've been looking for an excuse to bestow it on someone. Thing gives me the heebie jeebies.

default_actions.speaker: MURMUR
default_actions.text: Well met, Pachinko Man. How fares the Soul Ankh? Have you fed it any innocent souls lately?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I'll, um... I'll let you know.

scissors.speaker: MURMUR
scissors.text: You would do battle with me?! Very well! I accept your challenge. Prepare to sample MY blade!

scissors.epitaph: YOU'VE BEEN DECAPITATED BY THAT GUY'S SWORD. NOT SURE HOW HE MANAGED THAT, SINCE YOU ARE LITERALLY A WALKING HEAD.

mug.speaker: MURMUR
mug.text: No, really! It's yours now! I realize it's an overwhelming gesture.

lens.speaker: MURMUR
lens.text: Hmm. I have been dispensing many a Mighty Relic lately. I hope I've not been irresponsible in that respect.

lens.speaker: MURMUR
lens.text: Oh, hey! That boy is holding the Artifact I gave Melissa. Charming girl! I wonder what she's up to these days.

hatemail.speaker: MURMUR
hatemail.text: A missive for a thief? Do you mean to impinge on my honor by handing me this, sir?!

hatemail.epitaph: WELL, THAT DIDN'T TAKE LONG. DUDE PULLED OUT A SWORD AND CORED YOU LIKE AN APPLE. SMOOTH MOVES!

hatemail.speaker: MURMUR
hatemail.text: Ah. A conversation piece, then. Nice stationary!

hatemail.speaker: MURMUR
hatemail.text: ...of course, you're right to be diligent in your pusuit. A truly crafty demon might appear anywhere - in any form.

hatemail.speaker: BAAL
hatemail.text: MAYBE THE THIEF WAS YOU ALL ALONG! RIGHT? "AND THEN PACHINKO MAN WAS THE DEMONS!" TOTALLY CALLING THIS.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hmm... this looks significant.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: This projector seems to be in pretty bad shape.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: WHOAH, STAND BACK EVERYONE, DR. NORTON MCAFFEE'S ON THE CASE. GOT ANY OTHER FRESH DIAGNOSES TO LAY DOWN?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Maybe if we... swapped the RAM, and the... kiloflops...?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: DON'T QUIT YOUR DAY JOB, KID. OH WAIT, YOU CAN'T. BECAUSE YOU'RE TRAPPED HERE FOREVER. HA.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: The old girl's up and running again, powering through points as smooth as you like!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I see. Was it a problem with the... with the RAM? Not enough kiloflops?

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Firstly, projectors don't have RAM. Secondly, that's not a real word. Thirdly, you are a nub.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: I'M NOT SURE WHICH ONE OF YOU SEEMS LAMER TO ME RIGHT NOW.
